question: At fixed 19200-energy generation per world, does spatial distribution of energy sources and/or deterministic passive local particle-contact transfer affect energy absorption, accessibility, mobility and native chemistry?
scientific_scope: New external treatment module only; original World/Config/chemistry code unchanged. No organisms, seeded templates, genomes or inherited traits.

design.base_config: M6 unfed-6101 chemistry, no catalysis; movement_cost=1 as M7.1; zero bonds initially
design.identical_start: four arms of each seed have exactly matching initial ids, positions, species, particle energies, RNG fingerprint/draw count

controlled_energy.overflow: discard as original engine; unchanged injection and dissipation

passive_contact_transport.when: After each original M7.1 base World.advance(1) step, once per tick; BEFORE later tick.
passive_contact_transport.scope: Every undirected cardinal-neighbor particle contact (including bonded and unbonded) in toroidal lattice. Includes S3. Existing bond strength unchanged. No transport via empty grid sites.
passive_contact_transport.method: Snapshot particle energies at the END of base step. Enumerate unique undirected contacting particle index pairs sorted by persistent (id_a,id_b). If snapshot energy gap >=2, propose 1 energy from higher to lower. Accept proposals in that fixed order only while donor remaining energy >=1; simultaneously apply all accepted transfers from accumulator deltas. A recipient can receive multiple units. Do not re-evaluate gradients during one transfer pass.
passive_contact_transport.no_external_flux: Moves energy only among existing particle stores. Exact pre/post sum(particle energies) invariant each tick. No RNG draws, no changes to particle positions, species, identity, bonds, world counters or source buffers.
passive_contact_transport.energy_cost: 0 for transport; an idealized passive exchange, not biological energy-pumping or thermodynamically complete model.
passive_contact_transport.off: Skip the entire transfer pass after base World.advance(1); no changes to existing original World.advance.
passive_contact_transport.check: Raise on any negative energy, net energy creation, changed RNG state, changed particle positions/IDs/bonds or energy ledger mismatch. Unit test contact, wrap, donor exhaustion, no-contact and no-intervention replay.

outcomes.per_world: Full energy ledger stored+dissipated+unabsorbed=initial+injected; energy-injection, source-overflow, particles at zero-energy, per-particle energy Gini, mobile-energy-eligible count, late accepted moves, late new bond formation, source contact transfers, total particle vs bond energy, final native ring components.
outcomes.independent_unit: Numeric seed: four arms paired by initial particle state; not 320 independent worlds.
outcomes.primary_source_comparison: In no-transfer arms, dispersed vs clustered has strictly lower source overflow in >=60/80 paired seeds AND strictly more accepted late moves (ticks 501..600) in >=48/80 seeds. Both required; if not, not_met.
outcomes.primary_transfer_comparison: In dispersed geometry, passive transport vs no-transfer strictly reduces number of zero-energy particles at tick600 in >=50/80 paired seeds AND has strictly more accepted late moves in >=48/80 seeds. Both required; if not, not_met.
outcomes.secondary: Report paired contrasts for all four arms at 100 and 600 on overflow, zero-energy particle fraction, Gini, late activity and bond formation, native rings. Count ties. Do not choose a posteriori favorable gate.
outcomes.no_claim: A positive gate is a statement about resource access and activity in this model, NOT metabolism, self-maintenance, replication or heredity.

integrity.fixed_replay_each_shard: Replay all 4 arms for first seed of each 20-seed shard; verify complete world hash, RNG, counters, injection/overflow, source stored-energy and total transfer events.
integrity.passive_off_consistency: Dispersed no-transfer arm must reproduce exactly M7.1 driven_no_catalysis dynamics if constructed with same seed, grid/particles and sources.
